core_obligations: Statement (lines 2508-2514): for U an m-truncated simplicial object and n <= m, the limit of U(n) over (Delta/[n])_{<= m}^{opp} exists and is canonically isomorphic to U_n.

Verification (proof lines 2508-2514): the index category (Delta/[n])_{<= m} has a final object, namely id: [n] -> [n], since n <= m; a limit over a category with a final object evaluates at that object, which here is U_n.
proof_roadmap: Identify the final object of the truncated slice category.
Recall that limits over categories with a final object evaluate there.
difficulty_reason: Trivial coskeleton (statement 2508-2514, proof 2516-2520): complete one-observation argument - final object id_[n] exists because n <= m, and limits over final-object categories evaluate at the final object. H3.
